# `<e-date-picker>`

<p><img alt="e-date-picker screenshot" src="__tests__/__screenshots__/inputs-datepicker--empty.png" width="480" /></p>

Single-day picker with a popover month grid.

Form-associated: participates in `<form>` submission and FormData.

> Source: [date-picker.ts](./date-picker.ts)

| Attribute          | Type      | Default        | Description                                             |

| `required`         | `boolean` | —              | Requires a selected date.                               |
